unit_text: The second question was whether accuracy would hold at a centre whose reports played no part in prompt development. Prompts were written and revised over three rounds on 200 reports from centre A, and reports from centre B were seen only at test time. At centre B the model reached an accuracy of 95.4% (95% CI 93.9 to 97.5), which lies within the interval of the overall estimate. Clinical text models often lose accuracy when moved between hospitals because templates, abbreviations and grading habits differ [@vandermeer2024external]. Our result confirms that an open-weight model prompted without fine-tuning generalises across Swiss university hospitals. Both centres write their reports in German and use the same reporting software.
